title.zh: 卷二十一 本紀第二十一 神宗二 光宗
title.raw: 卷二十一 本紀第二十一 神宗二 光宗 Volume 21 Annals 21: Shenzong 2

sentences.zh: 神宗二

translations.literal: Shenzong 2.
translations.idiomatic: Annals of Shenzong, Part Two.

sentences.zh: 二十五年春正月丙辰，朝鮮使來請援。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, spring, first month, day bingchen: Korean envoys came to request aid.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year, in the first month of spring, on bingchen, Korean envoys arrived to plead for military aid.

sentences.zh: 二月丙寅，复議征倭。

translations.literal: Second month, day bingyin: campaign against the Wo was again deliberated.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on bingyin, the court again deliberated launching a campaign against Japan.

sentences.zh: 丙子，前都督同知麻貴為備倭總兵官，統南北諸軍。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: former Vice Regional Commander Ma Gui was made overall commander for coastal defense against the Wo, commanding northern and southern armies.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi former vice regional commander Ma Gui was appointed overall commander for coastal defense against Japan, with command over northern and southern forces.

sentences.zh: 三月乙巳，山東右參政楊鎬為僉都御史，經略朝鮮軍務。

translations.literal: Third month, day yisi: Yang Hao, Right Vice Administrator of Shandong, was made Censor-in-Chief and commissioner of Korean military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on yisi, Yang Hao, right vice administrator of Shandong, was made censor-in-chief and put in charge of Korean military affairs.

sentences.zh: 己未，兵部侍郎邢玠為尚書，總督薊、遼、保定軍務，經略禦倭。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: Xing Jie, Vice Minister of War, was made Minister of War, overall commander of Ji, Liaodong, and Baoding military affairs, and commissioner for defense against the Wo.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Xing Jie, vice minister of war, was promoted to minister of war, made overall commander of military affairs in Ji, Liaodong, and Baoding, and appointed commissioner for defense against Japan.

sentences.zh: 夏六月戊寅，皇極、中極、建極三殿災。

translations.literal: Summer, sixth month, day wuyin: the three halls Huangji, Zhongji, and Jianji burned.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of summer, on wuyin, the three halls Huangji, Zhongji, and Jianji were destroyed by fire.

sentences.zh: 癸未，罷修國史。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: compilation of the national history was halted.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei work on the national history was suspended.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸巳，誡諭群臣。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day guisi: the assembled ministers were admonished.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on guisi, the assembled ministers received an admonitory edict.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔赦天下。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: an edict proclaimed amnesty throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou an edict proclaimed amnesty throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 是月，楊應龍叛，掠合江、綦江。

translations.literal: That month, Yang Yinglong rebelled and plundered Hejiang and Qijiang.
translations.idiomatic: That month Yang Yinglong rose in rebellion and raided Hejiang and Qijiang.

sentences.zh: 八月丁丑，倭破朝鮮閒山，遂薄南原，副總兵楊元棄城走，倭逼王京。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day dingchou: the Wo broke Korean Hansan, then pressed on Nanwon; Assistant Regional Commander Yang Yuan abandoned the city and fled; the Wo approached Wangjing.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on dingchou, Japanese forces overran Hansan in Korea, then pressed toward Nanwon; assistant regional commander Yang Yuan abandoned the city and fled, and the Japanese closed on Wangjing.

sentences.zh: 甲申，京師地震。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: the capital was shaken by an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen the capital shook with an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 九月壬辰，逮前兵部尚書石星下獄，論死。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day renchen: former Minister of War Shi Xing was arrested and imprisoned; he was sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renchen, former minister of war Shi Xing was arrested and thrown into prison, and condemned to death.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲戌，安南黎惟潭篡立，款關請罪，詔授安南都統使。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jiaxu: Le Duy Dam of Annam usurped the throne, came to the border with submission to beg forgiveness, and was by edict invested as Pacification Commissioner of Annam.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jiaxu, Le Duy Dam of Annam seized the throne, submitted at the frontier to beg forgiveness, and was by edict invested as pacification commissioner of Annam.

sentences.zh: 是年，琉球入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Ryukyu entered with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Ryukyu sent a tribute mission.

sentences.zh: 二十六年春正月，官軍攻倭於蔚山，不克，楊鎬、麻貴奔王京。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, spring, first month: government troops attacked the Wo at Ulsan but could not take it; Yang Hao and Ma Gui fled to Wangjing.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year, in the first month of spring, government troops attacked the Japanese at Ulsan but failed to take it, and Yang Hao and Ma Gui fled back to Wangjing.

sentences.zh: 三月癸卯，賜趙秉忠等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: Third month, day guimao: Zhao Bingzhong and others were granted the jinshi degree with passed ranks and origin appointments of differing grades.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on guimao, Zhao Bingzhong and others received jinshi degrees, with palace passes and provincial appointments ranked by grade.

sentences.zh: 壬子，群臣詣文華門疏請皇長子冠婚，不允。

translations.literal: Day renzi: the assembled ministers presented memorials at the Wenhua Gate requesting the crown prince's capping and marriage; [the request] was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi the assembled ministers submitted memorials at the Wenhua Gate asking that the crown prince be capped and married, but the request was denied.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁卯，遼東總兵官李如松出塞，遇伏戰死。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day dingmao: Li Rusong, Regional Commander of Liaodong, went beyond the border, encountered an ambush, and died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on dingmao, Li Rusong, regional commander of Liaodong, went beyond the frontier, fell into an ambush, and was killed in battle.

sentences.zh: 壬申，京師旱，敕修省。

translations.literal: Day renshen: drought in the capital; an edict ordered self-examination and reform.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen drought struck the capital, and an edict called for self-examination and reform.

sentences.zh: 六月丁巳，楊鎬罷。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day dingsi: Yang Hao was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on dingsi, Yang Hao was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 戊午，中官李敬採珠廣東。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: the eunuch Li Jing gathered pearls in Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu the eunuch Li Jing was sent to gather pearls in Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，張位罷。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: Zhang Wei was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Zhang Wei was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 丙子，巡撫天津僉都御史萬世德經略朝鮮。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: Wan Shide, Censor-in-Chief and Governor of Tianjin, was made commissioner of Korean affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Wan Shide, censor-in-chief and governor of Tianjin, was appointed commissioner of Korean affairs.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙戌，中官魯保鬻兩淮餘鹽。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day bingxu: the eunuch Lu Bao sold surplus salt from the Two Huai regions.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on bingxu, the eunuch Lu Bao sold off surplus salt from the Two Huai regions.

sentences.zh: 八月丁丑，京師地震。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day dingchou: the capital was shaken by an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on dingchou, the capital shook with an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 九月壬辰，免浙江被災田租。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day renchen: land tax in disaster-stricken Zhejiang was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renchen, land tax was forgiven in disaster-stricken Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙卯，總兵官劉綎、麻貴分道擊倭，敗之。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day yimao: Regional Commanders Liu Ting and Ma Gui attacked the Wo by separate routes and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on yimao, regional commanders Liu Ting and Ma Gui struck the Japanese by separate routes and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 董一元攻倭新砦，敗績。

translations.literal: Dong Yiyuan attacked the Wo at Xincai and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Dong Yiyuan attacked the Japanese at Xincai and suffered defeat.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊戌，倭棄蔚山遁，官軍分道進擊。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day wuxu: the Wo abandoned Ulsan and fled; government troops pursued by separate routes.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on wuxu, the Japanese abandoned Ulsan and fled, and government troops pursued them by separate routes.

sentences.zh: 十二月，總兵官陳璘破倭於乙山，朝鮮平。

translations.literal: Twelfth month: Regional Commander Chen Lin defeated the Wo at Yishan; Korea was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month regional commander Chen Lin routed the Japanese at Yishan, and Korea was pacified.

sentences.zh: 是年，烏斯藏入貢。

translations.literal: That year, U-Tsang entered with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year U-Tsang sent a tribute mission.

sentences.zh: 二十七年春二月壬子，分遣中官領浙江、福建、廣東市舶司。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, spring, second month, day renzi: eunuch officials were separately dispatched to head the maritime trade superintendentates of Zhejiang, Fujian, and Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year, in the second month of spring, on renzi, eunuch officials were dispatched separately to take charge of the maritime trade superintendentates of Zhejiang, Fujian, and Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 是月，貴州巡撫江東之遣兵討楊應龍，敗績。

translations.literal: That month, Jiang Dongzhi, Governor of Guizhou, sent troops against Yang Yinglong and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: That month Jiang Dongzhi, governor of Guizhou, sent troops against Yang Yinglong and suffered defeat.

sentences.zh: 三月己亥，前兵部侍郎李化龍總督川、湖、貴州軍務究。

translations.literal: Third month, day jihai: former Vice Minister of War Li Hualong was made overall commander of military affairs in Sichuan, Huguang, and Guizhou, with mandate to investigate and suppress.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jihai, former vice minister of war Li Hualong was appointed overall commander of military affairs in Sichuan, Huguang, and Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 討楊應龍。

translations.literal: To suppress Yang Yinglong.
translations.idiomatic: His charge was to investigate and suppress Yang Yinglong.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲戌，御午門，受倭俘。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiaxu: [the emperor] received Wo captives at the Meridian Gate.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jiaxu, the emperor received Japanese captives at the Meridian Gate.

sentences.zh: 是月，臨清民變，焚稅使馬堂暑，殺其參隨三十四人。

translations.literal: That month: a popular uprising in Linqing burned the tax commissioner Ma Tang's office and killed thirty-four of his attendants.
translations.idiomatic: That month a popular uprising broke out in Linqing; the crowd burned tax commissioner Ma Tang's office and killed thirty-four of his attendants.

sentences.zh: 閏月丙戌，以倭平，詔天下，除東征加派田賦。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day bingxu: because the Wo had been pacified, an edict was issued throughout the realm remitting the extra land tax levies imposed for the eastern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on bingxu, because Japan had been pacified, an edict was issued throughout the realm abolishing the extra land taxes levied for the eastern expedition.

sentences.zh: 己丑，久旱，敕修省。

translations.literal: Day jichou: after prolonged drought, an edict ordered self-examination and reform.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, after prolonged drought, an edict called for self-examination and reform.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以諸皇子婚，詔取太倉銀二千四百萬兩。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: because of the imperial princes' weddings, an edict ordered that 24 million taels of silver be taken from the Great Storehouse.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, because of the imperial princes' weddings, an edict ordered 24 million taels of silver drawn from the Great Storehouse.

sentences.zh: 戶部告匱，命嚴核天下積儲。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Revenue reported the treasury empty; an order was issued to strictly audit accumulated stores throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Revenue reported the treasury depleted, and an order went out to conduct strict audits of accumulated stores throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 六月己亥，楊應龍陷綦江，參將房嘉寵、游擊張良賢戰死。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jihai: Yang Yinglong took Qijiang; Participating General Fang Jiachong and Mobile Corps Commander Zhang Liangxian died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jihai, Yang Yinglong captured Qijiang; participating general Fang Jiachong and mobile corps commander Zhang Liangxian were killed in battle.

sentences.zh: 秋八月甲午，陝西狄道縣山崩。

translations.literal: Autumn, eighth month, day jiawu: a mountain collapsed in Didao County, Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on jiawu, a mountain collapsed in Didao County, Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 九月，土蠻犯錦州。

translations.literal: Ninth month: Tuman raiders invaded Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the Tuman raided Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬午，振京城饑民。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day renwu: famine relief was provided for hungry people in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on renwu, famine relief was sent to hungry people in the capital.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以播州用兵，加四川、湖廣田賦。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: because of military operations in Bozhou, land taxes in Sichuan and Huguang were increased.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, because of military operations in Bozhou, land taxes in Sichuan and Huguang were increased.

sentences.zh: 戊子，貴州宣慰使安疆臣有罪驗證。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: An Jiangchen, Pacification Commissioner of Guizhou, was found guilty upon verification.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi An Jiangchen, pacification commissioner of Guizhou, was found guilty upon investigation.

sentences.zh: 詔討賊自贖。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that he redeem himself by attacking bandits.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that he redeem himself by campaigning against the rebels.

sentences.zh: 十一月己酉，免河南被災田租。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiyou: land tax in disaster-stricken Henan was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiyou, land tax was forgiven in disaster-stricken Henan.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，振畿輔及鳳陽等處飢。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: famine relief was sent to the capital region and places such as Fengyang.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou famine relief was sent to the capital region and to places such as Fengyang.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁丑，武昌、漢陽民變，擊傷稅使陳奉。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day dingchou: popular uprisings in Wuchang and Hanyang wounded the tax commissioner Chen Feng.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on dingchou, popular uprisings in Wuchang and Hanyang wounded tax commissioner Chen Feng.

sentences.zh: 戊子，振京師就食流民。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: famine relief was sent to migrants seeking food in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi famine relief was sent to refugees coming to the capital to seek food.

sentences.zh: 是年，琉球入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Ryukyu entered with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Ryukyu sent a tribute mission.

sentences.zh: 二十八年春二月戊寅，京師地震。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, spring, second month, day wuyin: the capital was shaken by an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year, in the second month of spring, on wuyin, the capital shook with an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，李化龍帥師分八路進討播州。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: Li Hualong led the army in eight columns to advance against Bozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Li Hualong led his forces in eight columns to advance against Bozhou.

sentences.zh: 夏六月丁丑，克海龍囤，楊應龍自縊死，播州平。

translations.literal: Summer, sixth month, day dingchou: Hailong Stockade was taken; Yang Yinglong hanged himself; Bozhou was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of summer, on dingchou, Hailong Stockade was taken, Yang Yinglong hanged himself, and Bozhou was pacified.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛亥，旱，敕修省。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day xinhai: drought; an edict ordered self-examination and reform.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on xinhai, drought persisted and an edict called for self-examination and reform.

sentences.zh: 八月辛未，慈慶宮成。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day xinwei: Ciqing Palace was completed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on xinwei, Ciqing Palace was completed.

sentences.zh: 丙子，罷朝鮮戍兵。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: garrison troops in Korea were withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi the Korean garrison was withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 九月甲寅，停刑。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiayin: executions were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiayin, executions were suspended.

sentences.zh: 是秋，炒花犯遼東，副總兵解生等敗沒。

translations.literal: That autumn, Chaohua invaded Liaodong; Assistant Regional Commander Xie Sheng and others were defeated and killed.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn Chaohua invaded Liaodong; assistant regional commander Xie Sheng and others were defeated and killed.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛未，貴州皮林苗叛，總兵官陳璘討之。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day xinwei: the Pilin Miao of Guizhou rebelled; Regional Commander Chen Lin was sent to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on xinwei, the Pilin Miao of Guizhou rose in rebellion, and regional commander Chen Lin was dispatched to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 丙子，雲南稅監楊榮開採阿瓦、孟密寶井。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: Yang Rong, tax commissioner of Yunnan, opened mining of precious wells at Ava and Möng Mit.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Yang Rong, the Yunnan tax commissioner, opened mining at the precious wells of Ava and Möng Mit.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙未，御午門，受播州俘。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day yiwei: [the emperor] received Bozhou captives at the Meridian Gate.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on yiwei, the emperor received Bozhou captives at the Meridian Gate.

sentences.zh: 是年，兩畿各省災傷，民飢盜起，內外群臣交章請罷礦稅諸監，皆不聽。

translations.literal: That year, disaster struck the two capital regions and every province; the people hungered and bandits arose; ministers inside and outside the court submitted memorial after memorial requesting abolition of mining taxes and the various commissioners; [the emperor] would not listen.
translations.idiomatic: That year disasters afflicted the two capital regions and every province; the people went hungry and bandits rose; ministers inside and outside the court submitted memorial after memorial asking that mining taxes and the various commissioners be abolished, but the emperor would not listen.

sentences.zh: 大西洋利瑪竇進方物。

translations.literal: From the Great Western Ocean, Matteo Ricci presented local products.
translations.idiomatic: Matteo Ricci of the Atlantic presented tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 二十九年春正月壬子，以播州平，詔天下，蠲四川、貴州、湖廣、雲南加派田租逋賦，除官民詿誤罪。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, spring, first month, day renzi: because Bozhou had been pacified, an edict was issued throughout the realm remitting extra land rents and overdue levies in Sichuan, Guizhou, Huguang, and Yunnan, and pardoning official and commoner errors.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year, in the first month of spring, on renzi, because Bozhou had been pacified, an edict was issued throughout the realm remitting extra land rents and overdue levies in Sichuan, Guizhou, Huguang, and Yunnan and pardoning errors by officials and commoners alike.

sentences.zh: 是月，皮林苗賊平。

translations.literal: That month, the Pilin Miao rebels were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Pilin Miao rebels were suppressed.

sentences.zh: 二月甲戌，振大同、宣府飢。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiaxu: famine relief was sent to Datong and Xuanfu.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jiaxu, famine relief was sent to Datong and Xuanfu.

sentences.zh: 三月乙卯，賜張以誠等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: Third month, day yimao: Zhang Yicheng and others were granted the jinshi degree with passed ranks and origin appointments of differing grades.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on yimao, Zhang Yicheng and others received jinshi degrees, with palace passes and provincial appointments ranked by grade.

sentences.zh: 是月，武昌民變，殺稅監陳奉參隨六人，焚巡撫公署。

translations.literal: That month: a popular uprising in Wuchang killed six attendants of tax commissioner Chen Feng and burned the governor's office.
translations.idiomatic: That month a popular uprising in Wuchang killed six attendants of tax commissioner Chen Feng and burned the governor's yamen.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙酉，徵陳奉還，以守備承天中官杜茂代之。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day yiyou: Chen Feng was recalled; the eunuch Du Mao, garrison commander of Chengtian, was sent to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on yiyou, Chen Feng was recalled, and the eunuch Du Mao, garrison commander of Chengtian, was sent to replace him.

sentences.zh: 五月，蘇州民變，殺織造中官孫隆參隨數人。

translations.literal: Fifth month: a popular uprising in Suzhou killed several attendants of the weaving commissioner, the eunuch Sun Long.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month a popular uprising in Suzhou killed several attendants of the weaving commissioner, the eunuch Sun Long.

sentences.zh: 六月，京師自去年六月不雨，至是月乙亥始雨。

translations.literal: Sixth month: the capital had had no rain since the sixth month of the previous year; only in this month, on yihai, did rain finally fall.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month the capital had gone without rain since the sixth month of the previous year; only on yihai of this month did rain finally come.

sentences.zh: 山東、山西、河南皆大旱。

translations.literal: Shandong, Shanxi, and Henan all suffered severe drought.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong, Shanxi, and Henan all suffered severe drought.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，法司請熱審，不報。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: the judicial offices requested the summer judicial review; no reply was given.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai the judicial offices requested the summer judicial review, but received no reply.

sentences.zh: 是夏，振畿內飢。

translations.literal: That summer, famine relief was sent within the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: That summer famine relief was sent within the capital region.

sentences.zh: 秋九月壬寅，河決開封、歸德。

translations.literal: Autumn, ninth month, day renyin: the Yellow River breached at Kaifeng and Guide.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of autumn, on renyin, the Yellow River broke through at Kaifeng and Guide.

sentences.zh: 丁未，趙志皋卒。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Zhao Zhigao died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Zhao Zhigao died.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，振貴州飢。

translations.literal: Day guichou: famine relief was sent to Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou famine relief was sent to Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 戊午，前禮部尚書沈鯉、硃賡並兼東閣大學士，預機務。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: former Ministers of Rites Shen Li and Zhu Geng were both made concurrent Grand Secretaries of the Eastern Pavilion and joined deliberation on state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu former ministers of rites Shen Li and Zhu Geng were both made concurrent grand secretaries of the Eastern Pavilion and entered deliberation on state affairs.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己卯，立皇長子常洛為皇太子，封諸子常洵福王，常浩瑞王，常潤惠王，常瀛桂王。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jimao: the eldest imperial son Changluo was invested as crown prince; the other sons were enfeoffed—Changxun as Prince of Fu, Changhao as Prince of Rui, Changrun as Prince of Hui, and Changying as Prince of Gui.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jimao, the eldest imperial son Changluo was invested as crown prince; Changxun was enfeoffed as prince of Fu, Changhao as prince of Rui, Changrun as prince of Hui, and Changying as prince of Gui.

sentences.zh: 詔赦天下。

translations.literal: An edict proclaimed amnesty throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: An edict proclaimed amnesty throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，加上慈聖皇太后尊號。

translations.literal: Day renchen: an enhanced honorific title was added for the Empress Dowager Cisheng.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen an enhanced honorific title was added for the empress dowager Cisheng.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛未，詔复朵顏馬市。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day xinwei: an edict restored the horse market with the Tümed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on xinwei, an edict restored the horse market with the Tümed.

sentences.zh: 是年，琉球入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Ryukyu entered with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Ryukyu sent a tribute mission.

sentences.zh: 三十年春正月己未，以四方災異敕修省。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year, spring, first month, day jiwei: because of disasters and portents in every quarter, an edict ordered self-examination and reform.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year, in the first month of spring, on jiwei, because of disasters and portents throughout the realm, an edict called for self-examination and reform.

sentences.zh: 二月己卯，不豫，召大學士沈一貫於啟祥宮，命罷礦稅，停織造，釋逮擊，復建言諸臣職。

translations.literal: Second month, day jimao: [the emperor] was unwell; Grand Secretary Shen Yiguan was summoned to Qixiang Palace and ordered to halt mining taxes, stop imperial weaving operations, release those under arrest, and restore the posts of officials who had remonstrated.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jimao, the emperor fell ill and summoned grand secretary Shen Yiguan to Qixiang Palace, ordering him to halt mining taxes, stop imperial weaving, release those under arrest, and restore the posts of officials who had remonstrated.

sentences.zh: 翼日，疾瘳，寢前詔。

translations.literal: The next day, when his illness abated, he set aside the previous day's orders.
translations.idiomatic: The following day, when his illness eased, he revoked the previous day's edicts.

sentences.zh: 甲申，重建乾清、坤寧宮。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: the Qianqing and Kunning palaces were rebuilt.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen the Qianqing and Kunning palaces were rebuilt.

sentences.zh: 閏月丙申，复河套諸部貢市。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day bingshen: border-market trade with the Ordos tribes of the Yellow River bend was restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on bingshen, border-market trade with the Ordos tribes of the Yellow River bend was restored.

sentences.zh: 戊午，河州黃河竭。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: the Yellow River dried up at Hezhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu the Yellow River ran dry at Hezhou.

sentences.zh: 三月甲申，騰越民變，殺稅監委官。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiashen: a popular uprising in Tengyue killed a delegated official of the tax commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jiashen, a popular uprising in Tengyue killed a delegated official of the tax commissioner.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛丑，振順天、永平飢。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day xinchou: famine relief was sent to Shuntian and Yongping.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on xinchou, famine relief was sent to Shuntian and Yongping.

sentences.zh: 五月乙亥，法司請熱審，不報。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day yihai: the judicial offices requested the summer judicial review; no reply was given.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on yihai, the judicial offices requested the summer judicial review, but received no reply.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛巳，邊餉缺，命嚴催積逋。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day xinsi: border funds were short; an order was issued strictly to collect overdue payments.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on xinsi, border funds ran short, and an order was issued to press strictly for overdue payments.

sentences.zh: 是月，緬賊陷蠻莫宣撫司，宣撫思正奔騰越，賊追至，有司殺正以謝賊，始解。

translations.literal: That month: Burmese bandits took the Mangshi Pacification Superintendentate; Pacification Superintendent Si Zheng fled to Tengyue; the bandits pursued him there; local officials killed Zheng to appease the bandits, and only then was the crisis resolved.
translations.idiomatic: That month Burmese raiders overran the Mangshi pacification superintendentate; pacification superintendent Si Zheng fled to Tengyue, and when the raiders pursued him there local officials killed Zheng to appease them, and only then was the crisis resolved.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊戌，振江北災。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day wuxu: relief was sent for disaster in Jiangbei.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on wuxu, relief was sent for disaster-stricken Jiangbei.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，停刑。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: executions were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen executions were suspended.

sentences.zh: 是年，琉球、哈密入貢。

translations.literal: That year Ryukyu and Hami entered with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Ryukyu and Hami sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 三十一年春三月戊午，吏部奏天下郡守闕員，不報。

translations.literal: Year thirty-one, spring, third month, day wuwu: the Ministry of Personnel reported vacancies among prefects throughout the realm; no reply was given.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of Wanli thirty-one, on wuwu of the third month, the Ministry of Personnel reported vacancies among prefects throughout the realm, but received no reply.

sentences.zh: 是月，播州餘賊吳洪等作亂，有司討平之。

translations.literal: That month, remnants of Bozhou rebels Wu Hong and others rose in revolt; local officials suppressed them.
translations.idiomatic: That month remnants of the Bozhou rebels led by Wu Hong and others rose in revolt, and local officials suppressed them.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁亥朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day dinghai new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the dinghai new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 五月丙辰，閣臣請熱審，不報。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day bingchen: grand secretaries requested the hot-season judicial review; no reply was given.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on bingchen, grand secretaries requested the hot-season judicial review, but received no reply.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，京師地震。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: the capital was shaken by an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 鳳陽大雨雹，毀皇陵殿脊。

translations.literal: Fengyang suffered a great hailstorm that destroyed the roof-ridge of the imperial mausoleum hall.
translations.idiomatic: A great hailstorm in Fengyang destroyed the roof-ridge of the imperial mausoleum hall.

sentences.zh: 是夏，河決蘇家莊，北浸豐、沛、魚台、單縣。

translations.literal: That summer the Yellow River burst its banks at Sujiazhuang and flooded northward into Feng, Pei, Yutai, and Shan counties.
translations.idiomatic: That summer the Yellow River burst its banks at Sujiazhuang and flooded northward into Feng, Pei, Yutai, and Shan counties.

sentences.zh: 秋九月甲子，江北盜起。

translations.literal: Autumn, ninth month, day jiazi: bandits rose in Jiangbei.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of autumn, on jiazi, bandits rose in Jiangbei.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲申，停刑。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jiashen: executions were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jiashen, executions were suspended.

sentences.zh: 丙申，睢州賊楊思敬作亂，有司討擒之。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: the bandit Yang Sijing of Suizhou rose in revolt; local officials suppressed him and took him captive.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen the bandit Yang Sijing of Suizhou rose in revolt; local officials suppressed him and took him captive.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲子，獲妖書，言帝欲易太子，詔五城大索。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiazi: a seditious tract was seized stating that the emperor wished to replace the crown prince; an edict ordered a major search by the Five Wards.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiazi, a seditious tract was seized saying the emperor wished to replace the crown prince, and an edict ordered a major search by the Five Wards.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙戌，召見皇太子於啟祥宮，賜手敕慰諭。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day bingxu: the emperor summoned the crown prince at Qixiang Palace and granted an autograph edict to reassure him.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on bingxu, the emperor summoned the crown prince at Qixiang Palace and granted an autograph edict to reassure him.

sentences.zh: 三十二年春二月壬寅，閣臣請補司道郡守及遣巡方御史，不報。

translations.literal: Year thirty-two, spring, second month, day renyin: grand secretaries requested that provincial administrators, circuit intendants, and prefects be appointed and that touring censors be dispatched; no reply was given.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of Wanli thirty-two, on renyin of the second month, grand secretaries requested appointments to provincial administrator, circuit intendant, and prefect vacancies and the dispatch of touring censors, but received no reply.

sentences.zh: 三月甲子，乾清宮成。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiazi: the Qianqing Palace was completed.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jiazi, the Qianqing Palace was completed.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，賜楊守勤等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Yang Shouqin and others were granted jinshi ranks, palace degrees, and various provincial degrees according to merit.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Yang Shouqin and others received jinshi ranks, palace degrees, and provincial degrees according to merit.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛巳朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day xinsi new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the xinsi new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 是月，浚泇河工成。

translations.literal: That month dredging work on the Ji River was completed.
translations.idiomatic: That month dredging work on the Ji River was completed.

sentences.zh: 五月癸酉，雷火焚長陵明樓。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day guiyou: lightning fire burned the soul tower of Changling.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on guiyou, lightning fire burned the soul tower of Changling.

sentences.zh: 六月丙戌，以陵災，命補闕官卹刑獄。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day bingxu: because of the tomb disaster, an edict ordered vacant offices filled and clemency in criminal cases.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on bingxu, because of the tomb disaster, an edict ordered vacant offices filled and clemency in criminal cases.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，昌平大水，壞長、泰、康、昭四陵石梁。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: great flooding in Changping destroyed the stone bridges of the Chang, Tai, Kang, and Zhao tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou great flooding in Changping destroyed the stone bridges of the Chang, Tai, Kang, and Zhao tombs.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚戌，京師大雨，壞城垣。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day gengxu: heavy rains in the capital destroyed sections of the city wall.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on gengxu, heavy rains in the capital destroyed sections of the city wall.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，振被水居民。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: relief was granted to flood-stricken residents.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou the court granted relief to flood-stricken residents.

sentences.zh: 八月辛丑，群臣伏文華門，疏請修舉實政，降旨切責。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day xinchou: the assembled ministers prostrated themselves at the Wenhua Gate and submitted memorials requesting practical governance be restored; a stern edict was issued rebuking them.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on xinchou, the assembled ministers prostrated themselves at the Wenhua Gate and submitted memorials requesting practical governance be restored; a stern edict was issued rebuking them.

sentences.zh: 丙午，分水河工成。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: dredging work on the Fenshui River was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu dredging work on the Fenshui River was completed.

sentences.zh: 九月戊申，振畿南六府飢。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day wushen: famine relief was granted in the six prefectures south of the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on wushen, the court granted famine relief in the six prefectures south of the capital region.

sentences.zh: 閏月辛丑，武昌宗人蘊鉁等作亂，殺巡撫都御史趙可懷。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day xinchou: the clansman Yun Qin of Wuchang and others rose in revolt and killed Grand Coordinator and Censor-in-chief Zhao Kehuai.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on xinchou, the clansman Yun Qin of Wuchang and others rose in revolt and killed Grand Coordinator and Censor-in-chief Zhao Kehuai.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲寅，始敘平播州功。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jiayin: rewards were first distributed for suppressing Bozhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jiayin, rewards were first distributed for suppressing Bozhou.

sentences.zh: 是年，琉球、烏斯藏入貢。

translations.literal: That year Ryukyu and U-Tsang entered with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Ryukyu and U-Tsang sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 三十三年春正月，重修京師外城。

translations.literal: Year thirty-three, spring, first month: the outer walls of the capital were rebuilt.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of Wanli thirty-three, in the first month, the outer walls of the capital were rebuilt.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，銀定、歹成犯鎮番，總兵官達雲擊敗之。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: Yinding and Daicheng invaded Zhenfan; Regional Commander Da Yun defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Yinding and Daicheng invaded Zhenfan, and Regional Commander Da Yun defeated them.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛亥，蘊鉁等伏誅。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day xinhai: Yun Qin and his fellows were executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on xinhai, Yun Qin and his fellows were executed.

sentences.zh: 五月丙申，鳳陽大風雨，毀陵殿神座。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day bingshen: great wind and rain in Fengyang destroyed the spirit seat in the mausoleum hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on bingshen, great wind and rain in Fengyang destroyed the spirit seat in the mausoleum hall.

sentences.zh: 庚子，雷擊圜丘望燈高桿。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: lightning struck the tall lamp pole at the Circular Mound Altar.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi lightning struck the tall lamp pole at the Circular Mound Altar.

sentences.zh: 六月乙巳，以雷警，敕修省。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day yisi: because of this thunder portent, an edict ordered self-examination and reform.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on yisi, because of this thunder portent, an edict ordered self-examination and reform.

sentences.zh: 秋八月己巳，停刑。

translations.literal: Autumn, eighth month, day jisi: executions were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on jisi, executions were suspended.

sentences.zh: 九月甲午，昭和殿災。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiawu: the Zhehe Palace was destroyed by fire.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiawu, the Zhehe Palace was destroyed by fire.

sentences.zh: 丙申，京師地震。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: the capital was shaken by an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月辛巳，免淮陽被災田租。

translations.literal: Winter, eleventh month, day xinsi: field rent was remitted in Huaiyang for disaster-stricken lands.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on xinsi, field rent was remitted in Huaiyang for disaster-stricken lands.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬寅，詔罷天下開礦。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day renyin: an edict abolished mining operations throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on renyin, an edict abolished mining operations throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 以稅務歸有司，歲輸所入之半於內府，半戶、工二部。

translations.literal: Tax administration was restored to civil officials; half of annual revenue was sent to the inner court and half to the Ministries of Revenue and Works.
translations.idiomatic: Tax administration was restored to civil officials; half of annual revenue was sent to the inner court and half to the Ministries of Revenue and Works.

sentences.zh: 丙午，免河南被災田租。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: field rent was remitted in Henan for disaster-stricken lands.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu field rent was remitted in Henan for disaster-stricken lands.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以皇長孫生，詔赦天下。

translations.literal: Day yimao: because the emperor's eldest grandson was born, an edict proclaimed amnesty throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, because the emperor's eldest grandson was born, an edict proclaimed amnesty throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 開宗室科舉入仕例。

translations.literal: An examination route for imperial clansmen to enter office was established.
translations.idiomatic: An examination route for imperial clansmen to enter office was established.

sentences.zh: 罷採廣東珠池、雲南寶井。

translations.literal: Pearl fisheries in Guangdong and gem mines in Yunnan were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Pearl fisheries in Guangdong and gem mines in Yunnan were abolished.

sentences.zh: 三十四年春二月庚戌，加上皇太后徽號。

translations.literal: Year thirty-four, spring, second month, day gengxu: an honorific title was added for the empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of Wanli thirty-four, on gengxu of the second month, an honorific title was added for the empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，大學士沈鯉、硃賡請補六部大僚，不報。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: Grand Secretaries Shen Li and Zhu Geng requested that senior vacancies in the six ministries be filled; no reply was given.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Grand Secretaries Shen Li and Zhu Geng requested that senior vacancies in the six ministries be filled, but received no reply.

sentences.zh: 三月己卯，雲南人殺稅監楊榮，焚其屍。

translations.literal: Third month, day jimao: people in Yunnan killed tax commissioner Yang Rong and burned his corpse.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jimao, people in Yunnan killed tax commissioner Yang Rong and burned his corpse.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，真定、順德、廣平、大名災，蠲振有差。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: disasters struck Zhending, Shunde, Guangping, and Daming; remission and relief were granted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou disasters struck Zhending, Shunde, Guangping, and Daming; remission and relief were granted in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸亥，浚硃旺口河工成。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day guihai: dredging work on the Zhuwangkou River was completed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on guihai, dredging work on the Zhuwangkou River was completed.

sentences.zh: 五月癸酉，河套部犯延綏，官軍擊走之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day guiyou: Ordos tribes invaded Yan-sui; government troops drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on guiyou, Ordos tribes invaded Yan-sui, and government troops drove them off.

sentences.zh: 六月癸卯，緬甸陷木邦。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day guimao: Burma captured Mubang.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on guimao, Burma captured Mubang.

sentences.zh: 是月，畿內大蝗。

translations.literal: That month great locust swarms struck the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: That month great locust swarms struck the capital region.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸未，沈一貫、沈鯉致仕。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day guiwei: Shen Yiguan and Shen Li retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on guiwei, Shen Yiguan and Shen Li retired from office.

sentences.zh: 九月甲午，詔陝西嚴敕邊備。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiawu: an edict strictly ordered frontier defenses in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiawu, an edict strictly ordered frontier defenses in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙申，停刑。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day bingshen: executions were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on bingshen, executions were suspended.

sentences.zh: 十一月己巳，朵顏入犯，總兵官姜顯謨禦卻之。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jisi: the Tümed invaded; Regional Commander Jiang Xianmo repelled them.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jisi, the Tümed invaded, and Regional Commander Jiang Xianmo repelled them.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬子，南京妖賊劉天緒謀反，事覺伏誅。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day renzi: the heretical rebel Liu Tianxu of Nanjing plotted rebellion; the plot was discovered and he was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on renzi, the heretical rebel Liu Tianxu of Nanjing plotted rebellion; the plot was discovered and he was executed.

sentences.zh: 是年，安南、琉球入貢。

translations.literal: That year Annam and Ryukyu entered with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Annam and Ryukyu sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 蒙古喀爾喀諸部悉歸我大清。

translations.literal: All the Khalkha Mongol tribes submitted to our Great Qing.
translations.idiomatic: All the Khalkha Mongol tribes submitted to our Great Qing.

sentences.zh: 三十五年春正月辛未，給事中翁憲祥言，撫、按官解任宜候命，不宜聽其自去，不報。

translations.literal: Year thirty-five, spring, first month, day xinwei: Supervising Secretary Weng Xianxiang memorialized that grand coordinators and provincial censors relieved of office should await orders and should not be permitted to leave on their own; no reply was given.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of Wanli thirty-five, on xinwei of the first month, Supervising Secretary Weng Xianxiang memorialized that grand coordinators and provincial censors relieved of office should await orders rather than leave on their own, but received no reply.

sentences.zh: 二月戊戌，安南賊武德成犯雲南，總兵官沐睿禦卻之。

translations.literal: Second month, day wuxu: the Annam rebel Wu Decheng invaded Yunnan; Regional Commander Mu Rui repelled him.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on wuxu, the Annam rebel Wu Decheng invaded Yunnan, and Regional Commander Mu Rui repelled him.

sentences.zh: 三月辛巳，賜黃士俊等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu executions were suspended.

translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary eighth month, on gengxu, reconstruction of the Three Halls began.

translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Shandong suffered great drought; an edict ordered tax silver retained there to be used for famine relief.

translations.idiomatic: On dingmao the Ordos tribes invaded Yan-Sui; government troops resisted but were defeated, and Vice General Sun Hongmo was captured.

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day xinyou: the capital was shaken by an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on xinyou, the capital shook with an earthquake.

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day wuyin: famine relief was provided for starving people in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on wuyin, famine relief was sent to starving people in the capital.

translations.idiomatic: In the forty-fourth year, in the third month of spring, on the new moon of xinwei, there was a solar eclipse.

translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Qian Shangsheng and others received jinshi ranks, palace degrees, and provincial degrees according to merit.

translations.idiomatic: That spring the capital region, Shandong, Henan, Huai, and Xu suffered great famine; remissions and relief were granted according to circumstance.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊午，河南盜起，諭有司撫剿。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day wuwu: bandits rose in Henan; the local authorities were instructed to pacify and suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on wuwu, bandits rose in Henan; the emperor instructed the local authorities to pacify and suppress them.

translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renyin, the Ordos tribes invaded Yan-Sui, and Regional Commander Du Wenhuan repelled them.

translations.idiomatic: On dingmao the Yellow River broke through at Zhujiakou in Xiangfu, inundating the prefectures and counties of Chen, Qi, Sui, and Zhe.

translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on yiwei, Chang Jineng of the Ordos tribes invaded Gaojiabao; Assistant General Wang Guoxing was defeated and killed.

translations.idiomatic: That month Shaanxi suffered drought; Jiangxi and Guangdong suffered floods; Henan, Huai, Yangzhou, Changzhou, and Zhenjiang suffered locusts; and bandits rose in great numbers in Shandong.

translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on dingwei, executions were suspended.

sentences.zh: 十一月己巳，隆德殿災。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jisi: the Longde Hall was destroyed by fire.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jisi, the Longde Hall was destroyed by fire.

translations.idiomatic: In the forty-fifth year, in the second month of spring, on wuwu, because there had been no snow the previous winter and no rain since spring began, an edict called for self-examination and reform.

translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on xinwei, because the prison surveillance office lacked officials and long-imprisoned inmates were dying in large numbers, Grand Secretary Fang Congzhe and others made a request, but received no reply.

translations.literal: Day yihai: famine relief was provided for famine in Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai famine relief was sent to Jiangxi.

translations.literal: Summer, fifth month, day bingzi: because of prolonged drought, the emperor again instructed self-examination and reform.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on bingzi, because of prolonged drought, the emperor again instructed self-examination and reform.

sentences.zh: 六月丙申，畿南大饑，有司請振，不報。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day bingshen: the region south of the capital suffered great famine; the local authorities requested relief; no reply was given.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on bingshen, the region south of the capital suffered great famine; the local authorities requested relief, but received no reply.

sentences.zh: 是月，閣臣法司請熱審，不報。

translations.idiomatic: That month the grand secretaries and judicial officials requested a summer judicial review, but received no reply.

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day guihai, new moon: there was a solar eclipse.

translations.literal: Day dingmao: Wu Daonan left office due to bereavement.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Wu Daonan left office due to bereavement.

sentences.zh: 是年，兩畿、河南、山東、山西、陝西、江西、湖廣、福建、廣東災。

translations.literal: That year, the two capital regions, Henan, Shandong, Shanxi, Shaanxi, Jiangxi, Huguang, Fujian, and Guangdong suffered disasters.
translations.idiomatic: That year the two capital regions, Henan, Shandong, Shanxi, Shaanxi, Jiangxi, Huguang, Fujian, and Guangdong suffered disasters.

sentences.zh: 暹羅、烏斯藏入貢。

translations.idiomatic: Siam and U-Tsang sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 四十六年春二月乙巳，振廣東飢。

translations.literal: Forty-sixth year, spring, second month, day yisi: famine relief was provided for famine in Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-sixth year, in the second month of spring, on yisi, famine relief was sent to Guangdong.

translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Regional Commander Zhang Chengyin led troops to relieve Fushun but was defeated and killed.

translations.idiomatic: On gengchen seven tribes including Naiman submitted at the frontier.

translations.idiomatic: On xinsi executions were suspended.

translations.idiomatic: On yimao the capital shook with an earthquake.

translations.idiomatic: In the forty-seventh year, in the second month of spring, on yichou, Commissioner-in-Chief Yang Hao rallied the army at Liaoyang; Regional Commanders Li Rubai, Du Song, Liu Ting, and Ma Lin advanced beyond the frontier by separate routes.

translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Liu Ting's army advanced deep into Mount Abudali, and he died in battle.

translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Zhuang Jichang and others received jinshi ranks, palace degrees, and provincial degrees according to merit.

translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu court officials prostrated themselves at the Wenhua Gate, requesting that memorials be issued and that troops and supplies be increased, but received no reply.

translations.literal: Autumn, eighth month, day yimao: locusts in Shandong.

translations.idiomatic: On guihai Yang Hao was arrested.

translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on dingsi, famine relief was sent to the hungry in the capital region.

translations.literal: Twelfth month: the land tax was increased again throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the land tax was increased again throughout the realm.

translations.idiomatic: That year Siam sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 三月庚寅，復加天下田賦。

translations.literal: Third month, day gengyin: the land tax was again increased throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on gengyin, the land tax was again increased throughout the realm.

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day guichou: Empress Wang died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on guichou, Empress Wang died.

translations.literal: Day wuwu: the Emperor took ill and summoned Fang Congzhe to audience at the Hongde Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu the emperor took ill and summoned Fang Congzhe to audience at the Hongde Hall.

translations.literal: Day bingshen: he died, aged fifty-eight.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen he died, aged fifty-eight.

translations.idiomatic: His deathbed edict abolished all monopoly taxes and newly added weaving and manufacture items.

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiashen: posthumous honors were granted, the temple name Shenzong was bestowed, and he was buried at Dingling.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiashen, posthumous honors were granted, the temple name Shenzong was bestowed, and he was buried at Dingling.

sentences.zh: 光宗，崇天契道英睿恭純憲文景武淵仁懿孝貞皇帝，諱常洛，神宗長子也。

translations.literal: Guangzong, the Emperor of Honoring Heaven, Aligning with the Way, Sagacious and Wise, Respectful and Pure, Constitutional in Culture, Glorious in Martial Accomplishment, Profound in Benevolence, Manifest in Filial Piety and Steadfast Uprightness, taboo name Changluo, was Shenzong's eldest son.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Guangzong—honored after death as one who honored Heaven, aligned with the Way, and united sagacious wisdom, respectful purity, constitutional culture, glorious martial accomplishment, profound benevolence, manifest filial piety, and steadfast uprightness—was named Zhu Changluo and was Shenzong's eldest son.

sentences.zh: 母恭妃王氏。

translations.literal: His mother was Consort Gong of the Wang clan.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Consort Gong of the Wang clan.

sentences.zh: 萬曆十年八月生。

translations.literal: He was born in the eighth month of Wanli ten.
translations.idiomatic: He was born in the eighth month of Wanli ten.

sentences.zh: 神宗御殿受賀，告祭郊廟社稷，頒詔天下，上兩宮徽號。

translations.literal: Shenzong held court to receive congratulations, reported the birth at sacrifices to the suburban shrines, imperial temples, and the altar of soil and grain, issued an edict throughout the realm, and honored both empress dowagers with honorific titles.
translations.idiomatic: Shenzong held court to receive congratulations, reported the birth at sacrifices to the suburban shrines, imperial temples, and the altar of soil and grain, issued an edict throughout the realm, and honored both empress dowagers with honorific titles.

sentences.zh: 未幾，鄭貴妃生子常洵，有寵。

translations.literal: Before long Consort Zheng bore Changxun, and she enjoyed favor.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Consort Zheng bore Changxun, and she enjoyed favor.

sentences.zh: 儲位久不定，廷臣交章固請，皆不聽。

translations.literal: The succession remained unsettled for a long time; court officials submitted memorial after memorial in firm request, but [the emperor] would not listen.
translations.idiomatic: The succession remained unsettled for a long time; court officials submitted memorial after memorial in firm request, but the emperor would not listen.

sentences.zh: 二十九年十月，乃立為皇太子。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of year twenty-nine he was at last invested as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of year twenty-nine he was at last invested as crown prince.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，獲妖書，言神宗欲易太子，指斥鄭貴妃。

translations.literal: In year thirty-one a demonic tract was discovered stating that Shenzong wished to replace the crown prince and denouncing Consort Zheng.
translations.idiomatic: In year thirty-one a demonic tract was discovered stating that Shenzong wished to replace the crown prince and denouncing Consort Zheng.

sentences.zh: 神宗怒。

translations.literal: Shenzong was enraged.
translations.idiomatic: Shenzong was enraged.

sentences.zh: 捕逮株連者甚眾，最後得皦生光者，磔之。

translations.literal: Very many were arrested and implicated; finally one Jiao Sheng was found and dismembered.
translations.idiomatic: Very many were arrested and implicated; finally one Jiao Sheng was found and dismembered.

sentences.zh: 獄乃解。

translations.literal: The case was then closed.
translations.idiomatic: The case was then closed.

sentences.zh: 四十一年六月，奸人王曰乾上變，告孔學等為巫蠱，將謀不利於東宮，語連鄭貴妃、福王，事具《葉向高傳》。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of year forty-one the villain Wang Ri'gan submitted an urgent report accusing Kong Xue and others of witchcraft and plotting harm against the Eastern Palace; the affair connected Consort Zheng and the Prince of Fu—the full account is given in the biography of Ye Xianggao.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of year forty-one the villain Wang Ri'gan submitted an urgent report accusing Kong Xue and others of witchcraft and plotting harm against the Eastern Palace; the affair connected Consort Zheng and the Prince of Fu—the full account is given in the biography of Ye Xianggao.

sentences.zh: 四十三年夏五月己酉，薊州男子張差持梃入慈慶宮，事复連貴妃內璫。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer of year forty-three, on yiyou, a man of Jizhou named Zhang Cha entered the Ciqing Palace armed with a club; the affair again connected the consort's eunuchs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer of year forty-three, on yiyou, a man of Jizhou named Zhang Cha entered the Ciqing Palace armed with a club; the affair again connected the consort's eunuchs.

sentences.zh: 太子請以屬吏。

translations.literal: The crown prince requested that [Zhang Cha] be handed over to the regular officials.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince requested that Zhang Cha be handed over to the regular officials.

sentences.zh: 獄具，戮差於市，斃內璫二人於禁中。

translations.literal: When the case was concluded, Cha was executed in the marketplace and two palace eunuchs were put to death within the forbidden precincts.
translations.idiomatic: When the case was concluded, Cha was executed in the marketplace and two palace eunuchs were put to death within the forbidden precincts.

sentences.zh: 自是遂有「梃擊」之案。

translations.literal: From this there arose the case known as the "Stick Beating."
translations.idiomatic: From this there arose the case known as the Stick Beating.

sentences.zh: 四十八年七月，神宗崩。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of year forty-eight Shenzong died.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of year forty-eight Shenzong died.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，太子遵遺詔發帑金百萬犒邊。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: the crown prince, following the deathbed edict, disbursed one million taels from the treasury to reward the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou the crown prince, following the deathbed edict, disbursed one million taels from the treasury to reward the frontier.

sentences.zh: 盡罷天下礦稅，起建言得罪諸臣。

translations.literal: All mining taxes throughout the realm were abolished, and officials who had been punished for remonstrance were restored.
translations.idiomatic: All mining taxes throughout the realm were abolished, and officials who had been punished for remonstrance were restored.

sentences.zh: 己亥，再發帑金百萬充邊賞。

translations.literal: Day jihai: another million taels from the treasury were disbursed as frontier rewards.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai another million taels from the treasury were disbursed as frontier rewards.

sentences.zh: 八月丙午朔，即皇帝位。

translations.literal: On the bingwu new moon of the eighth month he ascended the throne.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu new moon of the eighth month he ascended the throne.

sentences.zh: 大赦天下，以明年為泰昌元年。

translations.literal: He proclaimed a general amnesty throughout the realm and declared the following year Taichang one.
translations.idiomatic: He proclaimed a general amnesty throughout the realm and declared the following year Taichang one.

sentences.zh: 蠲直省被災租賦。

translations.literal: Rent and tax were remitted in directly administered provinces stricken by disaster.
translations.idiomatic: Rent and tax were remitted in directly administered provinces stricken by disaster.

sentences.zh: 己酉，吏部侍郎史繼偕、南京禮部侍郎沈飀為禮部尚書兼東閣大學士，預機務。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: Shi Jixie, Vice Minister of Personnel, and Shen Fei, Vice Minister of Rites at Nanjing, were made Ministers of Rites and concurrent Grand Secretaries of the Eastern Lodge and joined deliberation on state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Shi Jixie, vice minister of personnel, and Shen Fei, vice minister of rites at Nanjing, were made ministers of rites and also grand secretaries of the Eastern Lodge and entered state deliberations.

sentences.zh: 遼東大旱。

translations.literal: Great drought in Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: Liaodong suffered great drought.

sentences.zh: 庚申，蘭州黃河清，凡三日。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: the Yellow River ran clear at Lanzhou for three days in all.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen the Yellow River ran clear at Lanzhou for three days in all.

sentences.zh: 甲子，禮部侍郎何宗彥、劉一燝、韓爌為禮部尚書兼東閣大學士，預機務。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: He Zongyan, Liu Yijian, and Han Kuang, Vice Ministers of Rites, were made Ministers of Rites and concurrent Grand Secretaries of the Eastern Lodge and joined deliberation on state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi He Zongyan, Liu Yijian, and Han Kuang, vice ministers of rites, were made ministers of rites and also grand secretaries of the Eastern Lodge and entered state deliberations.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，南京禮部尚書硃國祚為禮部尚書兼東閣大學士，預機務。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Zhu Guozuo, Minister of Rites at Nanjing, was made Minister of Rites and concurrent Grand Secretary of the Eastern Lodge and joined deliberation on state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Zhu Guozuo, minister of rites at Nanjing, was made minister of rites and also grand secretary of the Eastern Lodge and entered state deliberations.

sentences.zh: 召葉向高。

translations.literal: Ye Xianggao was summoned.
translations.idiomatic: Ye Xianggao was summoned.

sentences.zh: 遣使卹刑。

translations.literal: Envoys were dispatched to show mercy in criminal matters.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys were dispatched to show mercy in criminal matters.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，帝不豫。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: the Emperor took ill.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin the emperor took ill.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，召對英國公張惟賢、大學士方從哲等十有三人於乾清宮，命皇長子出見。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: Zhang Weixian, Duke of Ying, Grand Secretary Fang Congzhe, and thirteen others in all were summoned for audience at the Qianqing Palace, and the eldest imperial son was ordered brought out to be seen.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Zhang Weixian, Duke of Ying, Grand Secretary Fang Congzhe, and thirteen others in all were summoned for audience at the Qianqing Palace, and the eldest imperial son was ordered brought out to be seen.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，大漸，復召從哲等受顧命。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: as his illness grew grave, Fang Congzhe and the others were again summoned to receive his final charge.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, as his illness grew grave, Fang Congzhe and the others were again summoned to receive his final charge.

sentences.zh: 是日，鴻臚寺官李可灼進紅丸。

translations.literal: That same day Li Kezhuo, an official of the Court of Imperial Entertainments, presented the Red Pill.
translations.idiomatic: That same day Li Kezhuo, an official of the Court of Imperial Entertainments, presented the Red Pill.

sentences.zh: 九月乙亥朔，崩於乾清宮，在位一月，年三十有九。

translations.literal: On the yihai new moon of the ninth month he died in the Qianqing Palace, having reigned one month, aged thirty-nine.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai new moon of the ninth month he died in the Qianqing Palace, having reigned one month, aged thirty-nine.

sentences.zh: 熹宗即位，從廷臣議，改萬曆四十八年八月後為泰昌元年。

translations.literal: When Xizong ascended the throne he followed the court's counsel and changed the period after the eighth month of Wanli forty-eight to Taichang one.
translations.idiomatic: When Xizong ascended the throne he followed the court's counsel and changed the period after the eighth month of Wanli forty-eight to Taichang one.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，上尊諡，廟號光宗，葬慶陵。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month: posthumous honors were granted, the temple name Guangzong was bestowed, and he was buried at Qingling.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter posthumous honors were granted, the temple name Guangzong was bestowed, and he was buried at Qingling.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：神宗衝齡踐阼，江陵秉政，綜核名實，國勢幾於富強。

translations.literal: Appraisal: Shenzong took the throne at a tender age; Jiangling held government, verified names against realities, and the nation's strength came near to prosperity and power.
translations.idiomatic: Appraisal: Shenzong took the throne at a tender age; Jiangling held government, verified names against realities, and the nation's strength came near to prosperity and power.

sentences.zh: 繼乃因循牽制，晏處深宮，綱紀廢弛，君臣否隔。

translations.literal: Thereafter he drifted in inertia and constraint, dwelt at ease deep within the palace, statutes and discipline fell into decay, and ruler and ministers were cut off from one another.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter he drifted in inertia and constraint, dwelt at ease deep within the palace, statutes and discipline fell into decay, and ruler and ministers were cut off from one another.

sentences.zh: 於是小人好權趨利者馳騖追逐，與名節之士為仇讎，門戶紛然角立。

translations.literal: Thereupon men of little worth who loved power and pursued profit raced and jostled after it, made enemies of men of reputation and integrity, and factional doors rose up to contend against one another.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon men of little worth who loved power and pursued profit raced and jostled after it, made enemies of men of reputation and integrity, and factional doors rose up to contend against one another.

sentences.zh: 馴至悊、愍，邪黨滋蔓。

translations.literal: Gradually, by the Tianqi and Chongzhen reigns, evil factions spread ever further.
translations.idiomatic: Gradually, by the Tianqi and Chongzhen reigns, evil factions spread ever further.

sentences.zh: 在廷正類無深識遠慮以折其機牙，而不勝忿激，交相攻訐。

translations.literal: Those in court who were upright lacked deep insight and far-sighted planning to break their teeth; unable to restrain their indignation, they attacked one another in turn.
translations.idiomatic: Those in court who were upright lacked deep insight and far-sighted planning to break their teeth; unable to restrain their indignation, they attacked one another in turn.

sentences.zh: 以致人主蓄疑，賢姦雜用，潰敗決裂，不可振救。

translations.literal: Thus the ruler nursed suspicion, the worthy and the wicked were employed together, and collapse and rupture came in a way that could not be mended.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the ruler nursed suspicion, the worthy and the wicked were employed together, and collapse and rupture came in a way that could not be mended.

sentences.zh: 故論者謂明之亡，實亡於神宗，豈不諒歟。

translations.literal: Therefore commentators say that the fall of the Ming in truth began with Shenzong—can that not be believed?
translations.idiomatic: Therefore commentators say that the fall of the Ming in truth began with Shenzong—can that not be believed?

sentences.zh: 光宗潛德久彰，海內屬望，而嗣服一月，天不假年，措施未展，三案構爭，黨禍益熾，可哀也夫！

translations.literal: Guangzong's hidden virtue had long been manifest and the realm looked to him, yet he reigned only one month; Heaven granted no length of years and his measures went unrealized; the Three Cases stirred contention and partisan disaster grew fiercer still—pitiable indeed!
translations.idiomatic: Guangzong's hidden virtue had long been manifest and the realm looked to him, yet he reigned only one month; Heaven granted no length of years and his measures went unrealized; the Three Cases stirred contention and partisan disaster grew fiercer still—pitiable indeed!
